R1_ETHBTC_REVERSION.statement: log(ETH/BTC) deviations from the 20-day mean beyond 1.5 sigma revert within 5 days
R1_ETHBTC_REVERSION.rule: dollar-neutral pair (0.5 ETH, -0.5 BTC or reverse), entry when |z|>1.5, hold 5 days, 7 bps per leg turnover, funding modelled per leg
R1_ETHBTC_REVERSION.data: Bitstamp BTCUSD daily + mirror ETHUSDT daily (EXPLORATORY-grade venue provenance) for 2018-2023-09; Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT 00:00 mark prices for holdout
R1_ETHBTC_REVERSION.HOLDOUT: 2025-11-01..2026-09-20 (one look, only if OOS passes; +1 day execution lag as in CT1 perps test)
R1_ETHBTC_REVERSION.pass: TRAIN net Sharpe >= 0.5; OOS net Sharpe > 0.3; HOLDOUT net Sharpe > 0

R2_ETHBTC_MOMENTUM.rule: long 60d winner / short loser, 0.5 each leg, rebalanced daily on sign change

C11_TSMOM_4H.statement: BTC trend on 4h bars (lookbacks 30/90/180 bars = 5/15/30 days) - VARIANT of the C1 trend family, counted as a variant not a unique hypothesis
C11_TSMOM_4H.pass: crypto promotion criteria (TRAIN 2015-19 >=0.5 & resid >=0.3; VAL >=0.3); OOS/holdout NOT run: purpose is diversification analysis vs CT1 (correlation reported)
